mapper.sql: h.homework_id,h.schedule_id,h.teacher_id,h.title,h.description,h.deadline,h.publish_time,h.status,h.del_flag,h.total_score,h.archive_flag,coalesce(nullif((select group_concat(s.course_class_name separator '、') from edu_homework_target t join edu_course_schedule s on s.schedule_id=t.schedule_id where t.homework_id=h.homework_id),''),(select s.course_class_name from edu_course_schedule s where s.schedule_id=h.schedule_id)) schedule_name
mapper.select: select ,e.schedule_id matched_schedule_id,ms.course_class_name matched_schedule_name,en.enrollment_id,e.parent_id,e.student_name,(select count(*) from edu_homework_submission x where x.homework_id=h.homework_id and x.enrollment_id=en.enrollment_id) submission_count,(select x.status from edu_homework_submission x where x.homework_id=h.homework_id and x.enrollment_id=en.enrollment_id order by x.submission_id desc limit 1) submission_status,(select x.final_score from edu_homework_submission x where x.homework_id=h.homework_id and x.enrollment_id=en.enrollment_id order by x.submission_id desc limit 1) final_score from edu_homework h join (select t.homework_id,t.schedule_id,min(t2.enrollment_id) enrollment_id from edu_homework_target t join edu_enrollment t2 on t2.schedule_id=t.schedule_id and t2.parent_id=#{parentId} and t2.del_flag='0' group by t.homework_id,t.schedule_id) en on en.homework_id=h.homework_id join edu_enrollment e on e.enrollment_id=en.enrollment_id join edu_course_schedule ms on ms.schedule_id=e.schedule_id where h.status in ('1','2') and h.archive_flag='0' and h.del_flag='0' order by coalesce(h.publish_time,h.create_time) desc

select ,e.enrollment_id,e.parent_id,e.student_name from edu_homework h join edu_homework_target t on t.homework_id=h.homework_id join edu_enrollment e on e.schedule_id=t.schedule_id and e.parent_id=#{parentId} and e.del_flag='0' where h.homework_id=#{homeworkId} and h.del_flag='0' and h.archive_flag='0' and e.schedule_id=#{scheduleId} order by e.enrollment_id limit 1

select ,e.enrollment_id,e.parent_id,e.student_name from edu_homework h join edu_homework_target t on t.homework_id=h.homework_id join edu_enrollment e on e.schedule_id=t.schedule_id and e.parent_id=#{parentId} and e.del_flag='0' where h.homework_id=#{homeworkId} and h.del_flag='0' and h.archive_flag='0' and e.schedule_id=#{scheduleId} and e.status='0' and e.enrollment_status in('1','报名成功','已确认') and e.enrollment_id=#{enrollmentId} order by e.enrollment_id limit 1
select from edu_homework h where h.homework_id=#{homeworkId}

select ,(select group_concat(t.schedule_id) from edu_homework_target t where t.homework_id=h.homework_id) target_ids,(select group_concat(concat(t.schedule_id,':',(select count(*) from edu_homework_submission s join edu_enrollment e on e.enrollment_id=s.enrollment_id where s.homework_id=h.homework_id and e.schedule_id=t.schedule_id),':',(select count(*) from edu_homework_submission s join edu_enrollment e on e.enrollment_id=s.enrollment_id where s.homework_id=h.homework_id and e.schedule_id=t.schedule_id and s.status='2')) order by t.schedule_id separator ',') from edu_homework_target t where t.homework_id=h.homework_id) target_counts,(select count(*) from edu_homework_submission s where s.homework_id=h.homework_id) submission_count,(select count(*) from edu_homework_submission s where s.homework_id=h.homework_id and s.status='2') reviewed_count from edu_homework h where h.teacher_id=#{teacherId} and h.del_flag='0' order by coalesce(h.publish_time,h.create_time) desc,h.create_time desc

select ,(select count(*) from edu_homework_submission s where s.homework_id=h.homework_id) submission_count from edu_homework h and h.title like concat('%',#{title},'%')and h.status=#{status}and h.archive_flag=#{archiveFlag}and h.del_flag=#{delFlag} order by h.create_time desc
select count(*) from edu_homework_submission where homework_id=#{homeworkId}
mapper.update: update edu_homework set status=#{status},publish_time=case when #{status}='1' and publish_time is null then now() else publish_time end,update_by=#{user},update_time=now() where homework_id=#{homeworkId}
mapper.delete: update edu_homework set del_flag='2',update_time=now() where homework_id=#{homeworkId}
mapper.select: select question_id,homework_id,question_type,question_text,options_json,correct_answer,score,sort_no from edu_homework_question where homework_id=#{homeworkId} order by sort_no,question_id
mapper.delete: delete from edu_homework_file where homework_id=#{homeworkId} and file_type='homework'
mapper.select: select file_id fileId,homework_id homeworkId,file_type fileType,file_name fileName,file_path filePath,file_size fileSize from edu_homework_file where homework_id=#{homeworkId} and file_type='homework'

select file_id fileId,homework_id homeworkId,submission_id submissionId,answer_id answerId,file_type fileType,file_name fileName,file_path filePath,file_size fileSize from edu_homework_file where submission_id=#{submissionId} and file_type='answer'

select file_id fileId,homework_id homeworkId,submission_id submissionId,answer_id answerId,file_type fileType,file_name fileName,file_path filePath,file_size fileSize from edu_homework_file where submission_id=#{submissionId} and file_type='review' order by file_id
mapper.delete: delete from edu_homework_file where submission_id=#{submissionId} and file_type='review'
mapper.select: select s.*,h.title homework_title,e.student_name from edu_homework_submission s join edu_homework h on h.homework_id=s.homework_id join edu_enrollment e on e.enrollment_id=s.enrollment_id where s.homework_id=#{homeworkId} and s.enrollment_id=#{enrollmentId} order by s.submission_id desc limit 1
select * from edu_homework_submission where submission_id=#{submissionId}

select s.*,h.title homework_title,e.student_name,e.schedule_id,sc.course_class_name schedule_name from edu_homework_submission s join edu_homework h on h.homework_id=s.homework_id join edu_enrollment e on e.enrollment_id=s.enrollment_id left join edu_course_schedule sc on sc.schedule_id=e.schedule_id where s.homework_id=#{homeworkId} and (h.teacher_id=#{teacherId} or #{teacherId}=1) order by s.submit_time desc
select answer_id,submission_id,question_id,answer_text,correct_flag,score,teacher_comment from edu_homework_answer where submission_id=#{submissionId} order by answer_id

select e.enrollment_id from edu_homework h join edu_homework_target t on t.homework_id=h.homework_id join edu_enrollment e on e.schedule_id=t.schedule_id where h.homework_id=#{homeworkId} and e.parent_id=#{parentId} and e.del_flag='0' and e.enrollment_status in ('报名成功','1') and e.status='0' order by e.enrollment_id limit 1
select schedule_id from edu_homework_target where homework_id=#{homeworkId}
select teacher_id from edu_course_schedule where schedule_id=#{scheduleId} and del_flag='0' and status='0'

select e.enrollment_id,e.student_name,t.schedule_id,sc.course_class_name schedule_name,case when s.submission_id is null then 0 else 1 end submitted,s.submission_id,s.final_score,s.status submission_status from edu_homework h join edu_homework_target t on t.homework_id=h.homework_id join edu_course_schedule sc on sc.schedule_id=t.schedule_id join edu_enrollment e on e.schedule_id=t.schedule_id and e.del_flag='0' and e.enrollment_status in ('报名成功','1') and e.status='0' left join edu_homework_submission s on s.homework_id=h.homework_id and s.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id where h.homework_id=#{homeworkId} and (h.teacher_id=#{teacherId} or #{teacherId}=1) order by t.schedule_id,e.student_name,e.enrollment_id

select ,e.schedule_id matched_schedule_id,s.course_class_name matched_schedule_name,e.enrollment_id,e.parent_id,e.student_name, (select count(*) from edu_homework_submission x where x.homework_id=h.homework_id and x.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id) submission_count, (select x.status from edu_homework_submission x where x.homework_id=h.homework_id and x.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id order by x.submission_id desc limit 1) submission_status, (select x.final_score from edu_homework_submission x where x.homework_id=h.homework_id and x.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id order by x.submission_id desc limit 1) final_score from edu_homework h join edu_homework_target t on t.homework_id=h.homework_id join edu_enrollment e on e.schedule_id=t.schedule_id join edu_course_schedule s on s.schedule_id=e.schedule_id where e.parent_id=#{parentId} and e.lesson_account_id=#{accountId} and e.del_flag='0' and e.status='0' and e.enrollment_status in ('1','报名成功','已确认') and h.status in ('1','2') and h.archive_flag='0' and h.del_flag='0' order by coalesce(h.publish_time,h.create_time) desc
